community_list_entries.name: LoCoMo Refined: Recalibrating LoCoMo with Stricter LLM Judging and A Cleaned Dataset

phase1_classification.kind_reason: Recalibrated LoCoMo: 1,382 questions, 337 revised after human audit, with a stricter Qwen3-14B judge. It evaluates recall of time, events, relationships and preferences in very long multi-session dialogues. The technical report is listed as 'coming soon'.
